messages:
maya: Noticed a sharp uptick in fncall validation failures from a single customer route (~12% over 8m). Looks like a schema mismatch after the validator v2.1 rollout. Can we triage routing and decide Console surfacing + billing behavior? :grimacing:

sam: Do we have an example payload? Is it the same array-vs-object thing again?

maya: Yep. Validator complains that `tool_response.data` should be an object but caller is sending an array. Sample:```json
{
  "tool": "index_search",
  "tool_response": {
    "data": [ { "doc_id": "x123", "score": 0.87 } ]
  }
}
```

chris: Historically we silently coerced the first element into an object for backcompat. v2.1 enforces strict shape and rejects. Current behavior: rejects hit degen route which returns a polite 502 to the app. Customer support got paged.

nora: Two fronts: platform policy and Console UX. Platform: we need a defined fallback mode that avoids surprising charges. Console: operators want a quick way to inspect the original payload, the validation diff, and the last successful sample for that route.

sam: I suggest a "graceful-fallback" feature for rollouts: when validator fails and the diff is one of a small set of coercible types (e.g., ARR_OBJ, SINGLETON_ARRAY), route to the fallback but mark the invocation with `validation_status=warn` and `billing_mode=compensate` (so billing leads can reconcile). Also emit `fncall.validation_event{outcome=warn|fail|ok,route=primary|fallback,validator=v2.1}`.

maya: That sounds reasonable. Complications: if fallback increases cost (different model or larger batch), we need a policy flag to optionally still bill. Default during a rollout should be no charge for warn events for 24h.

chris: On telemetry, let's include a compact `validation_code` like `ARR_OBJ` or `MISSING_KEY` and a `schema_version` label. Store full failing samples to audit logs (7d retention) referenced by a hashed sample id in metrics so Console can fetch them without leaking data.

nora: Console feature ideas: - show a tiny inline diff next to the request row - clickable "open sample" to view original json + validation errors - filter for only warn/fail events - rollout toggle: "Enable graceful-fallback (no-billing)" with a percentage slider and expected impact preview

sam: Implementation plan I can take: 1) router: add `billing_mode` tag propagation and a `validation_outcome` metric (small change), 2) validator: add `validation_code` generation and heuristic classifier for coercible diffs, 3) Console: add a column and sample link; product will iterate. Can deliver 1&2 today as a hotfix.

chris: Alerting: create rule that pages when `fncall.validation_event{outcome=fail} > 1%` for 10m OR when `outcome=warn` and fallback P50 latency > 2x baseline. Add sampling so only 0.5% of warn traces are stored but 100% of fail traces are retained for 7d.

maya: For the heuristic classifier, let's start conservative: treat ARR_OBJ, SINGLETON_ARRAY, and TYPE_COERCE as warn; everything else is fail. We'll need owners to maintain coercion whitelist per tool.

sam: I'll add unit tests for billing suppression (ensure billing counter not incremented when `billing_mode=compensate`) and end-to-end logs to ensure sample id is recorded.

chris: Devops note: we should also update the conductor so accounting ingestion ignores compensated events by default. Support needs an audit view that shows compensated vs billed calls for a customer.

nora: UX acceptance criteria: Console shows the sample id link, a short error message, and a suggested action: "Enable graceful-fallback for this validator" or "Rollback validator v2.1". Also show estimated token cost delta if routed to fallback.

maya: Quick mitigation: until the hotfix lands, let's enable an emergency route rule that treats this customer's traffic as permissive so they won't error. Then we can flip a small 10% canary of graceful-fallback once sam's patch is up.

sam: PR incoming: https://git.internal/redwood/rev-router/pulls/449 — adds metric label `validation_outcome`, `validation_code`, and `billing_mode` flag. Tests included. Hoping to merge in 90m.

devops-bot: deploy queued for rev-router@hotfix -> env=prod shard=eu-central-1 by sam

chris: I'll draft the alert and a one-pager for on-call that explains the triage steps: 1) check `validation_code` distribution, 2) if ARR_OBJ dominant -> enable graceful-fallback, 3) monitor fallback latency and token cost, 4) decide rollback if > threshold.

nora: Also request that product expose a one-click rollback for validator on the rollouts page.

maya: Thanks team. Priority: prevent customer impact and billing surprise. After sam's deploy, let's run a 30m canary at 10% and watch `fncall.validation_event` + billing ingest. I'll prepare the sample diffs and tag impacted account ids for Support.

sam: Patch merged and deployed to canary. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/rev-router/commit/ab12cd3

maya: Great — will flip 10% now for that customer and update slack in 30m with metrics. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
